title: GlydeAdRequestV1
description: Payload for ads.management_v1 — create, update, pause, or delete an ad campaign.

action.description: Operation to perform on the campaign.

campaignId.description: Existing campaign ID for update/pause/delete. Omit or null for create.

platforms.description: Ad platforms to target. Defaults to both when omitted.

urls.description: Landing page URLs to advertise. Required for create/update.

headline.description: Ad headline (max 30 chars). If omitted for create/update, LLM generates one.

description.description: Ad description (max 90 chars). If omitted for create/update, LLM generates one.

dailyBudgetUsd.description: Daily budget in USD. Required for create.

targetAudience.description: Free-text description of target audience for LLM copy generation.
